description: Vibe Patches v1.3.2: Morphe patches for 365Scores - ad-free, analytics removal, MicroG sign-in and update blocking.

patches.name: Block update screen
patches.description: Hides the 'This app is out of date' update screen, new version popup, and Google Play services update prompt.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Changes the version code of 365Score to prevent forced updates.

patches.name: Disable ads
patches.description: Disables Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) initialization and the app's own ad placements, removing banner, interstitial, rewarded, native and mediated ads.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Removes analytics and tracking (Firebase Analytics) from 365Score.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Makes Google sign-in and Google APIs work in the patched app by using MicroG RE instead of Google Play services. Requires MicroG RE to be installed.

patches.name: Spoof signature
patches.description: Makes the app report its original signing certificate to itself, so Firebase and Google APIs restricted to the original app keep working.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks 365Score premium/pro features (ad-free, tipster, plus, notification sounds).
